message: サバイバルに必要なもの

name: Sally
message: 「Hey, hey, is the Prez coming along too?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「He's probably worried whether you two will actually do your jobs properly」

name: Sally
message: 「After all, beef bowls are on the line~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「More importantly, why are you even here, Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh? Oh, to keep an eye on whether you're doing your job properly, Synn?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Plus, if I make the rounds to thank the cooperating shops while I'm at it, that's killing two birds with one stone」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, beef bowls are a separate thing」
With Eauderourke in the lead, they parade through Ryuusei Town.

name: Sally
message: 「There'll be tons of yummy food too!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, I'm pretty much done over here too」

name: Synn
message: 「Got it. Well then, shall we make the rounds outside the shopping district too?」

name: Sally
message: 「Prez, how's this, how's this? Are we being helpful?」
At this rate, it looks like we'll be able to draw in quite a crowd.

name: Sally
message: 「Do we get to eat beef bowls?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You bet. Plus, depending on the turnout on the day of, there might even be a second bowl in it for you……」

name: Sally
message: 「Hmm~? Prez, there are people in the park too!」

name: Sally
message: 「Ta-da! Don't forget to check out KiraFes~!」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm Sally-chan, idol of the Demon World\s07 And this here is my Boss」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmm. I'm Macaron. As you can see, I'm the Demon Lord, so keep that in mind, okay!」

name: Sally
message: 「Demon Lord? What's that, is it tasty?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ah, it's Big Brother and Big Sis Nana again」

name: Macaron
message: 「Why are you with the Demons? Bullying them again?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, we're not. They're helping out with Student Council work.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm telling you, the Student Council properly hired them」

name: Sally
message: 「Yep. If we advertise Kirafes, we get beef bowls♪」

name: Macaron
message: 「You guys actually have a surprisingly nice side to you!」

name: Sally
message: 「It's okay, I don't think so at all」

name: Macaron
message: 「W-Well, as long as it doesn't get in my way, I'll let it slide!」

name: Synn
message: 「...Macaron, aren't you interested in the Student Council?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm busy, so I'm not gonna help you out, okay!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, what's the ever-so-busy Mako-chan doing out in a place like this?」

name: Synn
message: 「A tent, and the remains of a campfire... It almost looks like you're camping out here」

name: Macaron
message: 「W-What's wrong with that! I'm doing it 'cause I want to!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I told you, it's so I can become a proper Demon Lord!」

name: Macaron
message: 「If I can't live independently like Master, I can't call myself full-fledged!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hahaha, back on the Demon Lord thing again...」

name: Synn
message: 「That mindset is admirable, but camping out in a place like this is dangerous」

name: Macaron
message: 「I'm fine! I'll manage with the survival skills Master taught me directly!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ho-ho. In that case, I also have secret money-saving techniques」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't try to compete with her. Yours is just being cheap」

name: Synn
message: 「I think there's some common ground there, though」

name: Macaron
message: 「Don't lump me in with Big Brother's pathetic little tricks」

name: Synn
message: 「T-That's a hurtful way to put it!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nihihi, I did it on purpose, so there」

name: Macaron
message: 「I don't need big brother's help at all!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You've got a cute face, yet you aren't cute at all, you little brat!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Waaah! Jeez, stop pulling my hood! Big Sis Nana!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tahahaha! Sorry, sorry. I've just been wanting to touch it for a while now」

name: Sally
message: 「Hey, Prez, think we can use this weird signboard for advertising?」

name: Synn
message: 「No way, Sally. You'll get hurt if you touch it carelessly」

name: Sally
message: 「For now~ I happen to have a marker on me, so...」

name: Macaron
message: 「U-Auuu... H-Huge... Something like this, no way, I can't handle it...」

name: Sally
message: 「Were you really that startled? Even though Boss's belly is so squishy」

name: Macaron
message: 「Aaauu... Noo... It hurts, I'm gonna die...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh dear, you scraped yourself. Hold on, I've got a bandage」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, Macaron. Eauderourke looks like he's sorry, too」

name: Macaron
message: 「Haa, uuu... Noo... No more of thiiis...」
She suddenly throws herself onto the ground, flailing her arms and legs wildly.

name: Macaron
message: 「Nooo, nooo~! Why'd you take it~! Meanie~!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Thaaat's miiiine~! I don't wanna be without iiit~!」

name: Synn
message: 「C-Calm down, Macaron. You're gonna get your coat dirty, okay?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey now, Maco! Stop being so selfish!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Geez, you're a big dummy, Big Brother!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Even though I told you to stop, doing something someone hates--I can't believe you!」
The Student Council's blunder is my blunder as the president, after all....

name: Macaron
message: 「W-Well, if you can promise you'll never pull a prank like this again, I'll forgive you」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well then, you two keep working hard at your job, okay」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahaha, rough luck for both of us, huh」

name: Macaron
message: 「If you're the leader, scolding your teammates when they need it is an important part of your job, you know!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll be more careful from now on...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Honestly, I thought you were gonna help me out, and you turned out to be totally useless」

name: Macaron
message: 「...A-And also... Big Brother, Big Sis Nana」

name: Macaron
message: 「About what happened earlier, um... it's a secret, okay!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I mean, the fact that I'm... helpless without Alzard! It's a super, super big secret, got it?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah... yeah, got it. I won't breathe a word.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, everybody's got stuff they don't want poked at, right?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Someday, eventually, I'm definitely gonna overcome it...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Mm... Alright, you guys can go now」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sure it's gonna be a really fun festival」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha. You really are a hard worker, Macaron」

name: Macaron
message: 「That's right! So I have no idea if I can go or not!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tahaha... I can't tell if they get along or not...」
